title: 精品率71%，云南这个边境小县全省第一 | China's Specialty-Coffee County ☕
description:
你杯里的咖啡，来自云南吗？评论区聊聊。

云南普洱有个边境小县叫孟连（孟连傣族拉祜族佤族自治县），却藏着中国最好的咖啡之一：2024/25 产季精品率高达 71%，连续多年领跑云南全省。全县咖啡种植面积 11.16 万亩，涉及约 1.6 万户咖农、123 家企业；生豆年产量约 1.25 万吨，全产业链产值超 13 亿元。从 1988 年开始规模化种植，到如今被称作「中国精品咖啡第一县」——靠的就是清晨上山、只摘红透果子的手工功夫。一颗小豆子，种出了一个县的名字。

Deep in Yunnan's border country, a small county called Menglian grows some of China's finest coffee. In the 2024/25 season its specialty-grade rate hit 71% — tops in Yunnan province for years running. The county farms about 110,000 mu (~7,400 ha) of coffee across some 16,000 households and 123 companies, producing roughly 12,500 tonnes of green beans a year and over ¥1.3B in whole-chain output. Grown at scale since 1988, Menglian is now called China's No.1 specialty-coffee county — built on dawn climbs up the slopes to hand-pick only the ripe red cherries.

Facts only, no endorsement. AI-assisted edit; the subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
